Hello, this is Maetdol Games.
The Hidden Stage update is finally complete!
Thankfully, it wasn’t delayed as much as we feared.
v1.2.0 Update Details
A hidden stage that marks the culmination of the story has been added.
As it’s a "hidden" stage, you’ll need to meet certain conditions to access it.
Defeat the final boss.
Obtain the maximum amount of Nightmare Power. (It doesn't mean difficulty!)
Even if you’ve already defeated the final boss, you’ll need to defeat it again.
This is because you need to see the event that occurs after the ending credits!
As shown in the development diary, conditional doors have been added.
The name will simply be "Conditional Doors."
These doors can be opened by meeting specific conditions or by paying a price.
New weapons have been added: Club, Lantern, Staff, and Wings.
As shown in the development diary, consumable breakdown and slot expansion have been added.
The existing “Disassemble” and “Tactical Pocket” contracts now include the consumable breakdown and slot expansion functions.

notes.title: 5. New Totems, Sets, and Traces of Nightmare

items.text: 22 new totems, 10 new sets, 4 new blessings, and 6 new curses have been added.
Previously, you had to repeatedly press the attack key to attack.
This was intended to add fun through interaction and to make attacks feel more controllable.
However, this created an issue where the maximum attack speed couldn’t be fully utilized.
Now, you can hold down the key for continuous attacks!
But if you take damage, you’ll need to press the key again.
It’s frustrating when a hard-to-achieve set effect doesn’t feel rewarding.
The effects of some underwhelming sets have been improved.
Some sets have been reworked entirely, while others have had their performance increased. Check them out for yourself!
An option to track whether you’ve taken damage in your current playthrough or during boss fights has been added.
A golden heart indicates no damage taken during the entire playthrough.
A white heart shows no damage taken during a boss fight.
A red heart indicates no HP loss during a boss fight.: We hope this helps you with achievement hunting.: You can enable this option in the Gameplay settings.
Several achievements related to the new stage, weapons, and codex have been added.
We apologize to those who have already completed all achievements, but we believe new achievements bring fresh excitement. Thank you for your understanding!
In addition to these updates, minor adjustments that do not significantly affect gameplay have been made.
We apologize for not being able to document all the changes due to the extensive updates.
We are also managing a **Nightmare: The Lunatic** Discord server. Please join us there!

We’ve increased the visibility of the exclamation mark indicator above enemies' heads.

Now, you can check attack timing through Hit Areas.

'Nightmare Extractor' allows players to erode their weapons directly to strengthen their builds in the desired form.
'Reforger' allows players to select Reforge they want on their weapons, broadening the scope of builds.
We have adjusted the order of Contracts, prioritizing diversity over strengthening builds.

During battles with flying bosses (ex. Sol Dea), players often need to attack while in the air.
Due to the weapon's attack speed, there were instances where it was impossible to hit enemies in the air.

While this is an unavoidable characteristic of the weapons, we deemed it unreasonable for SP Attack consuming SP to also fail to hit enemies in the air, and have thus modified SP Attacks to be usable in the air.
Now, when using SP Attack during a fall, the fall speed will be reset.
The following weapons will no longer be affected by gravity when using their SP Attack in the air.
Bow
Revolver
Axe
Spear (Basic)
Buster Sword
Slime (Basic)
Gauntlet: Dirty Boxing
Orb
Sniper Rifle

notes.title: Modification of Totems Included in Each Set

items.text: The totems included in the set have been modified.
Most sets have totems added, but some sets exclude totems.: (Still, the total number of totems included in the set has increased!)
Some totems are included in multiple sets at the same time.
Even if you do not acquire the set, if you acquire the included totem at least once, it will be displayed in the collection.: (It will be recorded starting from this build.)
Fixed an issue where Bow: Wave's SPAttack arrows were blocked by the walls of Regina's arena.
Fixed an issue where the rat crossbowmen would attack in the direction opposite to the player.
Fixed an issue where Spear: Swiftness's basic attack sometimes did not work while overloading.
Fixed an issue where the friend did not return when the Curse: 'heavy friend' was removed.
Fixed an issue where the screen would appear blue when using Totem: 'Hourglass' in the boss room.
Fixed an issue where the One Strike, Seven Kills achievement was sometimes not cleared.
Fixed an issue where the Net Fighter would pull the player and trap them in the wall.
Explosive projectiles now explode each time they penetrate an enemy.
Reward chests now automatically move to the player's location when they land on a spike.
Sword: Rapid Drawing’s damage and range have been increased.
The second hit of the Sword: Penetration's overload attack becomes a critical hit.
The charging time of Hammer: Concentration has been reduced.
Hammer: Lightning's SP Attack sometimes electrocutes enemies.
Bow: Storm's basic attack now pierces enemies and bounces off walls.
The number of Bow: Wave's SP Attack arrows has been reduced and the damage has been increased.: (Total damage is the same.)
Even with Revolver: Special Munitions's overload attacks, the second bullet becomes a special bullet.
Revolver: Fanning has been modified to fire bullets directly at the parrying target.
The name of Buster Reforge has been changed to Sagnan Buster.
Buster Sword: Charge enhancement has been modified to Sagnan Sword.: -> The stance is fixed to the sword stance.
Slime: Elasticity's slime ball is treated the projectile.
Slime balls pop out even during Slime: Elasticity's overload attacks.
Slime: Split has been fixed.: -> Overload additional effect removed: -> SP Attack change: Cost 30, summons two slimes that last for 10 seconds.
Slime: Toxic Gas is emitted not only when dashing, but also when jumping, parrying, or landing.
Dual Blades: Coalescing duration has been increased to 5 seconds.
Dual Blades: Coalescing's buff does not disappear even after enhanced attack.
Dual Blades: Coalescing's SP Attack drags the enemy.
Dual Blades: Wield by Will has been modified.: -> Basic effect change: Swords proportional to ATK speed follow you.
You can now switch left and right directions during the shield's SP Attack.
Shield: Charge charging time has been reduced and charge distance has been increased.
Shield: Iron Wall has been modified.: -> SP Attack change: Cost 60, Summons a defense area that last for 15s. Staying in the area reduces DMG Taken by 30% and enhances parrying.
Shotgun: Magazine no longer requires reloading while overloaded.
When the Shotgun: Speedloader counterattacks, it fires mega round and does not consume bullets.
Gauntlets: Out-Boxer’s effect has been modified.
Gauntlets: In-Fighter's effect has been modified.
Orb: Amplification's SP Attack amplification amount has been increased.
Shuriken: Enlarge's shuriken summons a bouncing shuriken when it hits an enemy now.
Shuriken: Ambush's SP Attack now drops additional gold when killing an enemy.
When a Sniper Rifle: Penetrator's bullet penetrates an enemy, it explodes.
Sniper Rifle: Penetrator's SP Attack bullet ignores all enemy defenses.
Now, becomes invincible while the Greatsword's SP Attack jumping.
Greatsword: Charge's SP Attack cost is reduced to 15.
Greatsword: Run Up's charging time has been reduced and the hitting range when charging has been increased.
The blade that appears when using Totem: ‘Dancer’s Blade’ is now treated as a friend.
Corpse bats spawned through Totem: 'Corpse Bat' are now treated as friends.
You can move to OK by pressing the right key in the Input Settings.
When selecting weapons/totems, the focus will automatically move to reset once all selections are made.
Ability descriptions are displayed in the inventory.
Category shortcut keys have been added in the inventory/collection.
